name: huawei-band7-bpm-steps
title: Huawei Band 7 Heart Rate & Step Count Dataset
description: Minute-level heart rate (BPM) and step count data from a Huawei Band 7 wearable device, collected over 26 days from a single user for cross-modal BPM imputation research.

sources.title: Huawei Health App Data Export
sources.description: Data exported from Huawei Health app via Settings > Privacy > Request Data Export

conditions.activity_protocol: None — unstructured daily life (classes, studying, walking, sleeping)
conditions.sampling_mode: Device-controlled (not user-configurable); samples more frequently during detected activity

resources.name: bpm_data
resources.description: Raw heart rate readings exported from Huawei Health

fields.name: date
fields.description: Date of reading in M/D/YYYY format

fields.name: bpm
fields.description: Heart rate in beats per minute

fields.name: time
fields.description: Time of reading in HH:MM format (24-hour)

resources.name: step_data
resources.description: Raw step count intervals exported from Huawei Health

fields.name: date
fields.description: Date of interval in M/D/YYYY format

fields.name: steps
fields.description: Number of steps recorded in the interval

fields.name: time_start
fields.description: Interval start time in HH:MM format (24-hour)

fields.name: time_end
fields.description: Interval end time in HH:MM format (24-hour)

resources.name: timeline_aligned
resources.description: Minute-level aligned timeline merging BPM and step data, with derived features (activity, sleep detection)

fields.name: steps
fields.description: Step count in that minute (0 if none)

fields.name: bpm_missing
fields.description: 1 if BPM is missing, 0 if observed

fields.name: is_likely_sleeping
fields.description: True if detected as likely sleep period

resources.name: timeline_features
resources.description: Full feature-engineered timeline with 42 columns including temporal encodings, rolling step statistics, and neighboring BPM features

resources.name: imputed_bpm
resources.description: Timeline with Linear Regression and Random Forest imputed BPM values

resources.name: imputed_bpm_all
resources.description: Timeline with LR, RF, and SAITS imputed BPM values

heart_rate.missingness_type: MAR (Missing At Random — depends on time-of-day and activity level)
